_comment: Competition rules and model settings. Edit freely.

model._multi_blade_props_options: include = search 3/4-blade props too; exclude = 2-blade props only (the calibration comes from 2-blade bench tests, so it is unverified for 3/4-blade props). Same as --two-blade-only
model._thrust_cal_extrapolation_options: thrust calibration factor (keyed to blade tip speed) above the fastest bench point: hold = keep the last bench factor; linear = extend the slope of the last two bench points (floor 0.5); flat = mean of the group's bench factors at every tip speed
model._current_limit_mode_options: cap = assume the ESC limits current: motor current <= motor and ESC rating, battery current <= battery rating and max_system_current_a; reject = drop combos that exceed a rating; ignore = no limits

ranking_without_plane._metric_options: avg_thrust (mean thrust 0..avg_up_to_mps), static_thrust, net_thrust (avg_thrust minus propulsion mass), thrust_per_watt
